books.title: The Complete Gershwin Preludes for Piano
books.arranger_editor: Editor: Alicia Zizzo; Project Manager: Tony Esposito; Engraver: Fred Smith

songs.title: PRELUDE I
songs.notes: Allegro ben ritmato e deciso; first of the published Three Preludes (1926).

songs.title: PRELUDE II (Blue Lullaby)
songs.notes: Andante con moto e poco rubato; Gershwin called it a 'blue lullaby.' Second of the Three Preludes.

songs.title: PRELUDE (Fragment)
songs.notes: One of the unpublished/incomplete preludes restored in the Alicia Zizzo edition; precise date uncertain.

songs.title: PRELUDE (Melody No. 17)
songs.notes: Additional prelude (from Gershwin's notebooks) included in the Zizzo 'Complete' edition; date approximate.

songs.title: PRELUDE (Novelette in Fourths)
songs.notes: Restored prelude in the Zizzo edition; date approximate.

songs.title: PRELUDE (Rubato)
songs.notes: Restored prelude in the Zizzo edition; date approximate.

songs.title: PRELUDE (Sleepless Night)
songs.notes: Later prelude ('Sleepless Night') reconstructed in the Zizzo edition; date approximate.

songs.title: PRELUDE III (Spanish Prelude)
songs.notes: Allegro ben ritmato e deciso; third of the published Three Preludes, often called the 'Spanish' prelude.
